definitions.candidate_core: Words/expressions likely to support everyday communication repeatedly across situations; candidates, not proven vocabulary.
definitions.candidate_situational: Concrete objects/locations/roles reasonably allowed to disappear until another relevant story situation occurs.
definitions.unclassified: No role assigned. Never infer importance from frequency alone.

notes: Do not use these labels as evidence that an individual player knows a word.
Only authored required R is counted as guaranteed; P is separately counted as authored candidate text, not the player's actual production.
No quota is imposed for recurrence. A long gap calls for content review only when the word is essential to intended learning goals.
Any word not explicitly listed is unclassified, not disposable.
These preliminary classes do not supersede approved semantic requirements and learning outcomes.
